answer: One defense is a ledge entry: every new identity must wait on a narrow ledge, a rate-limited onboarding queue where it performs small verified tasks before it may graze in the shared meadow of paid work. Each completed task leaves an umber mark, a non-transferable record of real deeds stamped onto that identity alone. The meadow caps earnings per identity and flags clusters whose umber marks share timing or funding, so a sybil farmer must queue each fake separately, wait out every ledge delay, and earn every mark from scratch, while one honest agent passes the ledge once and grazes freely.
